events.address: Chelsea Triangle, W 14th St & 9th Ave, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day NEST New York NYFW fragrance activation built around the new Cardamom Latte Eau de Parfum, with a complimentary Cardamom Latte café in Chelsea Triangle.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary Cardamom Lattes and fragrance sampling are advertised while supplies last.
events.caveats: Complimentary drinks and sampling are while supplies last. Current sources agree on a 10 AM opening and Chelsea Triangle location, but one current secondary listing gives a 5 PM close while two others give 9 PM; this listing uses 9 PM and preserves the discrepancy here rather than treating the hours as unanimous.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 at Chelsea Triangle in the Meatpacking District. No RSVP or approval requirement is stated in the corroborating current listings.

events.event_name: Mary Kay Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A public NYFW beauty activation centered on Mary Kay's Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared campaign, with an oversized vanity experience, beauty touch-ups and interactive photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Mary Kay advertises 10,000 free makeup and skin-care products, plus beauty touch-ups and the public experience while promotional inventory lasts.
events.caveats: The organizer's Eventbrite listing is by Mary Kay U.S. and current secondary sources describe the experience as free and open to the public. Free products are promotional inventory and are not guaranteed to every attendee.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza. A registration page exists, but current public-event sources do not establish that advance registration is mandatory for public access.

events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW pop-up truck celebrating eos Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free Dewy Lip Shine sampling and treats are advertised while supplies last; the first 50 guests are advertised to receive a special jelly bag with the full collection.
events.caveats: The first-50 jelly-bag offer and all sampling/treats are inventory-dependent. Current sources describe the truck as open to the public and do not state an RSVP requirement.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway in SoHo. Arrive early for the first-50 offer.

events.address: Center Plaza, Rockefeller Center, 45 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10111
events.what_it_is: Cj Hendry's public Flower Market installation returning to Rockefeller Center with an entirely new lineup of plush flowers modeled on flowers native to New York City.
events.what_is_free: Entry is free and every guest receives one flower free. Additional flowers are $5 each.
events.caveats: Rockefeller Center says hours may change based on flower availability. Standard entry is free; a separate paid Flower Market Express option bundles priority entry with Top of the Rock and is not required for normal access.
events.practical_notes: September 24–27 at Center Plaza. Opening day is 1–8 PM; September 25–27 are 10 AM–8 PM.
